Using \(E=hc/\lambda\),

\[
\lambda=\frac{1240\ \text{eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{2.3393\ \text{eV}}
\approx 530\ \text{nm}.
\]

A wavelength of \(530\ \text{nm}\) is green light. A dye that appears/emits green absorbs its complementary color, red, in the usual complementary-color convention.

Answer: B
